description.en: Thylacoleo carnifex, the marsupial lion, in a neutral whole-body stance based on composite fossil anatomy. Soft tissues, coat, ears, colour and size are interpretive; the missing hind-foot hallux tip is conservatively completed. Climbing and tail-bracing remain functional hypotheses, not observed behaviour or a depicted hunting event.
description.zh: 袋狮 Thylacoleo carnifex 综合化石解剖作中性站姿全身复原。软组织、毛被、耳、颜色及尺寸为解释性补配；缺失的后足拇趾末端作保守补全。攀爬与尾支撑仍属功能推断，不代表已观察行为或特定捕猎事件。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original, whole-organism, refined low-poly reconstruction of the Pleistocene Australian marsupial Thylacoleo carnifex. Composite anatomical interpretation, not a fossil scan or one measured individual.

scientific_limits.en: Fossil anatomy is separated from inferred soft tissue, coat, color, ear shape and pose. The pedal hallux tip is missing in the cited specimens; a small blunt reconstruction is inferred, not observed. Climbing and tail-bracing are functional hypotheses, not witnessed behavior. This asset shows a neutral stance, not a claimed hunting event. Published museum size summaries and reconstructed skeletal proportions do not define an exact same-individual scale.
scientific_limits.zh: 化石解剖与软组织、毛被、颜色、耳形及姿态推定分开。所引足部标本缺少后足拇趾末端，小钝趾为保守补全而非直接观察。攀爬及尾支撑为功能推断，并非已观察行为。本件采用中性站姿，不复现特定捕猎事件。博物馆尺寸概述与复原骨架比例不能视为同一个体的精确尺寸。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Marsupialia, Diprotodontia, Thylacoleonidae; not a felid.

texture_policy.reason: Silhouette and tailored faceting carry this model; no copied photo texture or fur microgeometry.

scale.status: Illustrative adult-size design targets, not measurements of a particular fossil
scale.tolerance: Approximately 10 percent around artistic dimensions if needed for coherent anatomy; record any intentional change.

frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Quiet, low-headed, weight-bearing quadrupedal stance with slight fore-aft paw staggering. Hind heels are lowered. Tail extends back with a thick stable base, restrained distal descent and no tight curl. No tree, rock, prey, scene props, mane or display pedestal.

diagnostic_targets.target: Short, wide, deep cheek region and blunt muzzle; inset eyes and a continuous head-neck transition. No doglike long snout, felid saber canines or lion mane.
Robust braced chest and powerful forearms, with anatomical elbow/wrist transitions rather than exposed sphere joints. Four limbs and belly clearance remain readable.
Each forepaw has four smaller fingers plus the separate medial thumb bearing one enlarged curved claw. Thumb claws must be visibly larger, not claws on the outer wrist or on every digit.
Relatively firm lower back and muscular tapering tail; no long thin feline whip, bushy tuft or repeated beads.
Hindfeet use a low plantigrade pad, slender digits II-V with II/III paired closely, and a small divergent medial hallux restored bluntly. Do not copy the forepaw thumb-claw onto the hindfeet.
Nearly closed mouth, optionally parted slightly to reveal restrained incisors; avoid an invented complete dental display. Short coat and rounded ears remain understated artistic inferences.

art_direction.surface: Controlled, unevenly spaced facets along designed anatomical planes; primarily matte earth colors with a quieter belly region. No stripes, spots, wet/plastic skin or glossy oversized cartoon eyes.
art_direction.construction: Continuous profile lofts for torso/neck/tail and a deliberately shaped broad head. Use section transitions at shoulders, haunches, elbows and wrists. Primitive starting meshes may be heavily reshaped but untouched ellipsoids/cylinders may not constitute the animal.
geometry_priority: Four grounded paws and limb separation
art_direction.budget_rationale: Target roughly 6500-11000 triangles; 16000 is a practical ceiling for digit/claw readability and shoulder flow, not a fill target. The 48-primitive ceiling allows editable semantic groups; merge compatible export surfaces where useful without losing editability.

view_plan.final: Four exact-delivered-GLB views; perspective and preview may be identical bytes. Only add a local detail if a specific claw or contact issue is invisible in these views.
view_plan.website: No additional site images in prep or maker by default. Actual website renderer/config compatibility must be verified before claiming reuse; no guessed camera substitution.
